questions.question: If A - B means that A is the brother of B, A + B means that A is the sister of B, A × B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the brother of R?
questions.solution:
From the given information:

 
 

 A - B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

 A + B
 A is the sister of B
 
 

 A × B
 A is the father of B
 
 

Now we solve the equations in the options:

Option 1) P - Q + R 

⇒ P is the brother of Q, Q is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a2e2688b69f8546ee93530423de080ff434373c1aeec692f5ebd04f8ed4a088.png] 

Here P,Q and R are siblings therefore P is the brother of R.

Option 2) P + Q - R 

⇒ P is the sister of Q, Q is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08fec5355e75a72b7f5364758adb0ce3aff2d6c160fc8ac214300f146edfdb09.png] 

Here P,Q and R are siblings but P is the sister of R.

Option 3) P × Q + R 

⇒ P is the father of Q, Q is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b1a178af82838c2fafb90eb7d6672a65bb418b56cd2afd647146a6d5d520948.png] 

Here Q and R are siblings but P is the father. So P is the father of R.

Option 4) P - Q × R 

⇒ P is the brother of Q, Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/389129c4ebdd7b8048f558b9d0fc24f77c7cfe3a2593806995fd0a97b34c44c3.png] 

Here Q and P are siblings but Q is the father. So P is uncle of R.

Hence the correct answer is **option 1.**

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some tests are exams.

Some exams are viva.

All viva are theories.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some theories are exams.

II. Some theories are viva.

III. Some tests are viva.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
According to the given statements, we have

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0763e39f51ef4d472c438d1734c3a0f4f068f312d6a4c54b96f6c6f6ecda616b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some theories are exams.→Follows:[Since given some exams are viva and all viva are theories. So some theories are exams is definitely true.]

II. Some theories are viva.→Follows: [Since all viva are theories and so some theories are viva is definitely true.]

III. Some tests are viva.→ Does not follow: [Since given some tests are exams and some exams are viva. So some tests are viva is possible but not definitely true.]

Thus, **only conclusions I and II** follow.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 2**__'.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements: **

I. All Z are X.

II. All G are X.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some G are Z.

II. All X are G.

III. Some Z are X.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

questions.solution:
According to the given statements, we have,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d86f04ad0bccb2cba4d45355fc00cd9763213e621a4a7c90f1d6d581358161d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some G are Z.→ Does not follow [Since all G are X and all Z are X. So some G are Z is possible but not definitely true. This is not true.]

II. All X are G. → Does not follow [Since given all G are X and so some all X are G is possible but not definitely true. This is not true.]

III. Some Z are X. → Follows [Since given all Z are X and so some Z are X is definitely true. This is true.]

Thus, **only conclusion III** follows.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 2**__'.
